detailed_descriptions.en: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players with voice chat and terrifying monsters. Board a cursed flying ship and raid graveyards using shovels, crowbars, and improvised weapons. DIG GRAVES FOR TREASURE Coffins and crypts hide loot: some give powerful boosts (speed, super-jump, and more), some bring curses… You must also remember about monsters that might burst out of the ground. WATCH YOUR NOISE Most monsters hear everything: from shovels to voice chat. Scream once, and they’ll come for you. Feeling unlucky? A UFO could beam you straight into space! SPEND YOUR HAUL ON THE SHIP Vending machines dish out boosters and handy items, while the ship’s casino - blackjack, roulette and thimbles - lets you multiply your loot… or lose it all! GRAVEYARDS ARE BETTER WITH FRIENDS Invite up to 5 friends on Steam and dive into the chaos together. Solo? Go ahead - but nobody will hear you scream. FEATURES • 1–6 players in online co-op • Proximity voice chat with special voice effects • Monsters that hunt by sound - and UFO abductions • Boosters and cursed items straight from the graves • Full shipboard casino and bar • Pure chaos, friend betrayal, and nonstop mayhem

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Online co-op horror for 1–6 players with voice chat and terrifying monsters. Board a cursed flying ship and raid graveyards using shovels, crowbars, and improvised weapons.

DIG GRAVES FOR TREASURE

Coffins and crypts hide loot: some give powerful boosts (speed, super-jump, and more), some bring curses… You must also remember about monsters that might burst out of the ground.

WATCH YOUR NOISE

Most monsters hear everything: from shovels to voice chat. Scream once, and they’ll come for you. Feeling unlucky? A UFO could beam you straight into space!

SPEND YOUR HAUL ON THE SHIP

Vending machines dish out boosters and handy items, while the ship’s casino - blackjack, roulette and thimbles - lets you multiply your loot… or lose it all!

GRAVEYARDS ARE BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Invite up to 5 friends on Steam and dive into the chaos together. Solo? Go ahead - but nobody will hear you scream.

FEATURES

• 1–6 players in online co-op

• Proximity voice chat with special voice effects

• Monsters that hunt by sound - and UFO abductions

• Boosters and cursed items straight from the graves

• Full shipboard casino and bar

• Pure chaos, friend betrayal, and nonstop mayhem
